title: VTC Registry Sync Jobs Retry — payload
description: Requeue a trust-registry reconciliation job — one the community's reconciler has abandoned, or one waiting out a retry backoff — so it is dispatched on the reconciler's next pass.

jobId.description: The single job to requeue, from `vtc/registry/sync-jobs/list`. It may be `failed`, or `pending` and waiting out a retry backoff.

allFailed.description: Requeue every job in the terminal `failed` state. Spelled as its own member rather than an absent `jobId` so that a client bug which drops the identifier cannot silently become a bulk operation.

allWaiting.description: Bring forward every `pending` job that is waiting out a retry backoff. Never a held job. Its own member for the same reason as `allFailed`, and distinct from it so that repairing a shared cause and hurrying a slow backoff stay two decisions.

memberDid.description: The member whose record the requeued job carries.

from.description: The state the job was in. `failed` — the reconciler had abandoned it. `pending` — it was waiting out a retry backoff and has been brought forward.

reason.description: `inFlight` — the reconciler is dispatching the job now, so requeueing it would dispatch the same mutation twice. `held` — the job is deliberately delayed, and the delay is the point; it is never brought forward. `notFound` — no such job; it may already have been dispatched, retried, discarded, or swept.

Response.title: VTC Registry Sync Jobs Retry — response payload

requeued.description: Jobs now scheduled for dispatch on the reconciler's next pass. Empty is a valid answer and is not an error.

skipped.description: Jobs the maintainer declined to requeue, each with why. Reported rather than failing the task, so a bulk retry is not defeated by one ineligible row.
